title: VooPoo Argus G2 Pod Vape Kit
description: The VOOPOO Argus G2 Kit builds on the success of the Argus G, with the G2 version introducing enhanced performance, interactions, and a series of "Super Powers" - capacity, longevity, output, fast charging, and taste. Its features a colourful 0.96-inch TFT screen , offering a dynamic and user-friendly interface. Designed to cater to both mouth-to-lung (MTL) and restricted direct-to-lung (RDTL) vapers, the Argus G2 is as versatile as pod kits get. It comes with a newly designed 0.4ohm (RDTL) Argus Cartridge that has a 2ml e-liquid capacity and a convenient top-filling system. The kit supports three distinct vaping modes in addition to SHIFT mode (variable wattage) - SUPER for full-bodied flavour, SMART for an optimized experience, and ECO for minimizing power and e-liquid consumption, allowing you to tailor your vape to your preferences. Charging is a breeze with the Type-C USB port, ensuring your device is quickly ready for use. The Argus G2 is not just functional but stylish too, available in eight eye-catching colours, including Spray Black, Space Gray, and Aurora Purple, among others. The zinc alloy and PC materials ensure durability, while the smooth, polished surface offers a comfortable grip. Whether you’re transitioning from smoking to vaping or an experienced vaper looking for a reliable, high-performing kit, the Argus G2 by VOOPOO is designed to impress. Its streamlined design, combined with cutting-edge vaping technology, provides a premium vaping experience with every puff. RDTL 0.4ohm ARGUS Top Fill Pod, We recommend using High VG ( Sub-Ohm) E-liquid Only MTL 0.7ohm ARGUS Top Fill Pod, We recommend using 50/50 , Nic Salt or High PG E-Liquid Please note: When filling your pod with e-liquid for the first time, allow the pod to sit for ten minutes before use. This will allow the e-liquid to better saturate the wicking material, a type of cotton, to prevent dry hits and ensure the best flavour and performance from your coil.
